sloka: स तस्य मधुपर्कं गां पाद्यमर्घ्यं निवेद्य च ।पुलस्त्यमाह राजेन्द्रो हर्षगद्गदया गिरा ।। ७.३३.९ ॥
transliteration: sa tasya madhuparkaṁ gāṁ pādyamarghyaṁ nivedya ca ।pulastyamāha rājendro harṣagadgadayā girā ।। 7.33.9 ॥

translations.english: Having offered madhuparka, a cow, water for washing feet, and arghya to Pulastya, the king of kings then spoke to him with a voice choked with joy.
